items.title: Would You Still Want Dell If The AI Orders Slowed?
items.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) has returned more than 330% over the past twelve months, and it still cannot build as much as its customers want. You can be paid today for agreeing to buy the stock well below today's price, and the payment is yours whether or not you ever own the shares. The catch is whether you would want the shares at that lower price.

items.title: Should You Buy Dell Technologies Stock For All That AI Revenue?
items.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) has returned more than 360% over the past year and now sits right at the top of its 52-week range. Measured against sales it is still cheaper than the S&P 500. Measured against the cash it produces, it costs about twice the index. Both readings describe the same company, and the gap is the decision.
